Usage: ProtobuffEncoder.Tool <assembly-path> [output-dir] [csproj-path] [options]

  assembly-path   Compiled DLL with [ProtoContract] / [ProtoService] types
  output-dir      Override base output directory (default: from [ProtoToolOptions])
  csproj-path     .csproj to update with <Content Include=...> entries

Options:
  --verbose       Show per-file message / service / import counts
  --dry-run       Print what would be written without touching the file system
  --help, -h      Show this help

Assembly-level configuration (place in any .cs file in your project):

  [assembly: ProtoToolOptions(
      ProtoPath = "Contracts/Proto",
      Routes = [
          new ProtoTypeRoute("requests",  "Request", "Query"),
          new ProtoTypeRoute("responses", "Response", "Result"),
          new ProtoTypeRoute("messages",  "Message", "Event"),
      ]
  )]
